title: Into the mountains…
text: We spent a great day traveling through the Sierra Nevada mountains with Sebastian.  The small villages we visited were charming.  We were scheduled for a small group tour of 8 but the company canceled that trip with no explanation but provided us  with Sebastian and his taxi. It was a lucky change of plans. We greatly enjoyed talking with him and appreciated his expertise.  Great change from city tours.
author: Pioneer785113

title: A great day in the Alpujarra area
text: We thoroughly enjoyed spending our day with Ramon, our guide to two small villages in the Alpujarra region of Spain. He was well informed about the area and how it has evolved over the years with better roads and infrastructure. He knew the best shops to visit and how to navigate the steep and narrow paths of the towns. He took us to a popular restaurant that offered a range of local specialties, a place we would have never found on our own. We even encountered a few (100?) goats on our way back to Granada. author: andymZ6591CI

title: Fantastic tour to the Alpujarras!
text: We had a wonderful day in the Alpujarra mountains with our local guide, Ignacio, who showed us around. We visited picturesque villages, sampled local specialties, and got the chance to meet some of the locals. We also went on a short hike in the mountains, enjoying stunning views – it was absolutely lovely! Ignacio was an excellent guide – very friendly and knowledgeable. We highly recommend this tour!
author: Susanne M

title: The magic of La Alpujarra
text:
It was a very complete excursion visiting the Tablate bridge, Lanjarón, Capileira, Pampaneira, El Chorreón and the Agria fountain.
Three of us traveled in a taxi with a driver-guide, named Manuel, who was very friendly and explained everything to us very well.
author: Daniela C

title: A fantastic trip to wonderful villages set in magnificent scenery
text: The scenery was stunning and the villages fascinating. Our guide, Miguel, was hugely informative about the history and architecture of the area, as well as going out of his way to make sure we appreciated the full magnificence of the area.

title: Great tour of old world mountain villages and fabulous mountain views
text:

A big thank you also to the company for not cancelling the tour due to lack of numbers, really appreciated.
